thread:
sophie: Heads-up — noticed a burst of reconnects this morning that led to duplicated billing for some WS sessions. Client routed edge -> fallback dedicated and both sides charged. Anyone seen this?
arjun: Yikes. Do we have trace ids or logs? Can you paste a minimal repro?
sophie: Trace id 0d9f7b2. Quick repro: open socket, drop auth token, client reconnects, route swap happens while original lease still counted. Seems routing priority + tombstone TTL race.
zhao: I pulled logs for that trace. Saw resume accepted on edge then accepted on dedicated ~1.2s later. Metric: streaming.session.resume.duplicated +34 in 10m. Snippet:
```
edge: accept resume id=abc123
dedicated: accept resume id=abc123 (original session still active)
```
Router forwarded to dedicated before lease invalidation.
maria: UX note — console attributes cost per model/route but doesn't show per-session route handoff timeline. If we show resume decisions it would explain billing spikes to customers.
sophie: Proposed short-term fix: during resume handshake, check lease version + tombstone flag before routing to dedicated. If lease still active, either force sticky routing or reject resume with 409 so client backoffs. Minimal router-side change behind flag.
arjun: That adds a lease read on every resume. Any perf impact?
sophie: Read is cheap (Redis GET); can gate with feature flag and canary.
zhao: Telemetry needs to emit resume.decision={accepted|rejected|sticky} and include route_target so we can validate on canary. Also tag tenant_id and session_age.
maria: I'll prototype a console panel that surfaces resume.decision and a hover explaining billing impact. Also add duplicate_resume_count per tenant chart.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for 2025-07-12 02:00 UTC to eng-platform-canary. @sophie @arjun
sophie: :thumbsup: I'll open an RFC + PR. Runbook draft: 1) enable flag on canary 2) monitor streaming.session.resume.duplicated and resume.decision events 3) rollback if duplicates >2x baseline for 10m. @maria please prepare console patch.
arjun: Add alert thresholds? I'll wire an alert to paging if duplicates spike.
sophie: Baseline ~0.2/min per 1k sessions; alert if >1.0/min per 1k sessions sustained for 5m. Filing issue now.
